thread:
Ben (AE): quick sync request for Greenfield Health proofflow — need to lock down POC scope, success criteria, security asks, and pricing cushion. target pilot in ~6 weeks. can SEs give prioritized user journeys + concrete eval prompts? also need answers for InfoSec questionnaire. @Marisol?
Marisol (SE): happy to. my draft prioritization (MVP-first):
  1) clinician note summarization — endpoint: /summarize-note — real-time single-turn
  2) patient triage chat — endpoint: /triage-chat — stateful chat with context up to 512 tokens
  3) batch coding for billing — endpoint: /code-batch — offline batch job (csv in/out)
Which of these do we put in the MVP vs stretch? :thinking_face:
Ravi (PM): from infra side: dedicated pools can hit ~p50=120ms for <=128 tokens with our current kernels; p95 will vary by burst and batching. hosted has higher variability. recommend we set latency SLOs per-journey (summarization = p50<200ms, triage = p95<800ms). also suggest KV prefix caching for triage to cut cost.
Olivia (SE): success criteria suggestion (quick):
  - Summarization: ROUGE-L >= 0.60 on 200 eval prompts (domain-specific notes)
  - Triage chat: top-1 intent precision >= 0.85 on 200 test conversations
  - Billing code: exact match >= 0.80 on 500 historical invoices
  - Latency: as Ravi suggested, plus error rate <0.5%
Marisol (SE): drafting eval prompts now. example prompt set (will expand to 200 each):
```
# Summarization prompts (clinician notes)
Summarize the following patient encounter into a 3-sentence clinical note focused on diagnosis and plan:
[NOTE TEXT]

# Triage chat seed prompts
Patient: "I've been having chest pains when I walk up stairs."
System: """extract likely urgency and recommended next step"""

# Billing code prompt
Given the procedure descriptions in this CSV row, return the primary CPT code:
[CSV ROW]
```
Marisol (SE): acceptance buckets (short):
  - Functional correctness (metrics above)
  - Safety/regression (no hallucinated meds/procedures in summarization)
  - Ops (latency & error rate)
  - Security (no PHI persisted outside customer tenancy)
Ben (AE): commercial/Qs from buyer: they want committed throughput + discounted pricing for pilot. recommend proposing a 4-week dedicated trial + a 3-month commit option. suggested starting point: 5M tokens/month commit for pilot stage; note this is negotiable.
Ana (Customer): quick clarifications: we need SOC2 + encryption-at-rest + KMS integration. on-premise or VPC option is preferred for regulated workflows. timeline: pilot ready by end of Q2 is ideal. also can you confirm data retention & delete policies?
Ravi (PM): security quick answers: we support KMS + audit logs + per-tenant data isolation on Dedicated. on-prem requires legal/DPA + infra onboarding (estimate 3-6 weeks). data retention policies are configurable — default 30 days, can be shortened. I'll loop in security for the detailed questionnaire.
Olivia (SE): I'll own prompts & baseline eval harness. plan: 1 week for prompt collection + labeling, 2 weeks for eval runs & baseline metrics, 1 week tuning and metrics review, then integration with Greenfield test harness.
Marisol (SE): I'll build the technical playbook/runbook for the POC (endpoints, test data flow, fallback model variants, monitoring dashboards). small ask: need an owner on the customer's side to provide 200 labeled samples per journey and a secure S3/transfer. Ana — can you confirm? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ana (Customer): yes we can provide data. we will send a small sample set by EOW and a larger set within 2 weeks.
Ben (AE): action items summary:
  - Marisol: create POC runbook + acceptance spreadsheet (due tomorrow EOD)
  - Olivia: own prompt collection & eval harness (1w start)
  - Ravi: lead security questionnaire + confirm on-prem timeline (intro security by EOD)
  - Ben: draft SOW & trial commercial terms for 4-week Dedicated trial + optional 3-month commit
  - Ana: provide sample data and sign DPA
Sync: propose 2pm PT tomorrow for 30m alignment. :calendar: everyone ok?
deploy-bot: reminder — dedicated trial environments are provisioned after SOW accepted; provisioning ETA ~48 hrs after sign.
Marisol (SE): 2pm PT works for me. added a working doc: https://redwood-internal/drive/greenfield-poc-runbook — will post the acceptance spreadsheet there.
Olivia (SE): noted. I'll start scaffold for the eval harness and share results in the doc.
Ben (AE): perfect — thanks all. i'll send calendar invite and attach the draft SOW after this thread.
